description: Strade is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inlinea4infrastrutture.cittametropolitana.mi.it. The Infrastructure Area focused on the development of a unique road network of the CMM: any maintenance, programme and management assessment could not be disregarded by a single and formalised basis relating to the road network within the competence of the body. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include strade, strade provinciale. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/LimitationsOnPublicAccess/noLimitations). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
